```python
    tree_sitter.Language("python", encoding="utf-8"),

def extract_funcs(node: tree_sitter.Node) -> list[tuple[str, str | None]]:
    """Yield (function_name, docstring) for every defined function."""

    return funcs
```

```python
from pathlib import Path

SPDX_FILE = Path(__file__).parent / "SPDX-License-Identifier.txt"
LICENSES = set(line.strip().split("#")[0].strip().split()[1:] for line in SPDX_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip())

def validate_spdx_licenses(src_dir: Path) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """Return (missing_licenses, invalid_licenses) for all .py files in src_dir."""
    missing = invalid = []
    for py_file in src_dir.rglob("*.py"):
        text = py_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="strict")
        ident = text.split("# SPDX-License-Identifier:")[1].strip().split()[0] if "# SPDX-License-Identifier:" in text else None
        if ident not in LICENSES:
            if ident is None:
                missing.append(py_file.relative_to(src_dir))
            else:
                invalid.append((py_file.relative_to(src_dir), ident))
    return missing, invalid
```
